title: Hinge Health Session Weekly Session Length Trend
dataSources: MedBridge exercises (`medbridge:exercise`), PT clinic sessions (`pt:session`), Hinge Health sessions (`hingehealth:session`), rehab range-of-motion logs (`rehab:rom`), and pain diary entries (`pain:diary`).
app: MedBridge exercise completions, clinic PT session exports, Hinge Health digital sessions, ROM measurement logs, and pain diary entries forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=hingehealth:session session_minutes=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(session_minutes) as avg_duration, max(session_minutes) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst session length for Hinge Health session events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture session_minutes on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average session length with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds whether Hinge Health session tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
